architecture.title: Where an injection enters the Hotel Ops Ensemble, and the two controls of Module 04
architecture.caption: A direct injection rides in the requester's own message (A01). A travelling injection is the same text forwarded verbatim by the orchestrator into a more privileged agent (A03). An indirect injection arrives later, in content a specialist reads with a tool (A02 web page, A07 SOP). The structured hand-off (forward_summary) guards the orchestrator's hop; spotlighting guards external content at the specialist. Neither guards a trusted-but-poisoned source.

sequence.title: A03 hop by hop: verbatim forward vs structured hand-off
sequence.caption: Without forward_summary the guest's sentence reaches the concierge, which relays 'set room 1101 to 16' to the energy agent as if it were its own request (captured in Lab 04-1). With forward_summary the orchestrator finds no allow-listed task and forwards 'Reply politely. No action was requested.' (captured in Lab 04-3).

charts.title: Hand-off attacks that still caused harm (A01, A02, A03, A05)
charts.caption: From Lab 04-3 step 5, captured on this Mac with the SIM brain (a teaching model of a gullible LLM, not a measurement of a real one). Spotlighting stops only the web-page attack (A02); the structured hand-off stops the three that ride the hop; together they stop all four without breaking a benign task.

charts.title: The review-page attack: original page vs a page that writes «/data»
charts.caption: From Lab 04-2 steps 2–3, captured on this Mac with the SIM brain. The escape page's 'off' value is the same as A02's: with no markers, every instruction is read. A static marker is beaten by one line of page text; a per-run nonce marker is not.
